title: THE PIE-LAW ORTHOGONAL CHECK -- the phantom share's closed form (G187's constitution curve: s_ph(M) = s_b(M) x g(M), u = 0.185 (M/1e14)^+0.314 = (1-gamma)/2 - 1/3, rising 0.08 at 1e13 to 0.57 at 8e14) vs the INDEPENDENT per-object estimates (12 X-COP pie shares, 26 E11 group f_b floors, and the 2024-2026 gap literature): the pooled rms, the slope residual, the stiff u-exponent test, and the gap's verdicts.
context: G187 (the constitution curve s_ph(M) = s_b x g: 0.08 at 1e13 through the saturation to 0.57 at 8e14; u = 0.185 (M/1e14)^+0.314); G179 (the 12-cluster pie shares at R500: per-object s_ph = s_b/u, medians 17.7/56.9/24.6); G178 (the 26 groups at f_dust ~ 1 - f_b, the all-dust phase below M_sat = 3.09e14); G135/G200 (gamma = -0.282 for the (1-gamma)/2 - 1/3 identity; the q = -0.414 dust law).

functional_forms.s_ph_M500: s_b(M) x g(M); g = 1 (all-dust) below M_sat = 3.09e14, g = 1/u(M) (phantom) above; SHARP step / SMOOTH ramp across [1.73e14, 3.48e14]

gates.name: G0a [the curve's parameters] u = 0.185 (M/1e14)^+0.314 with the closed-form (1-gamma)/2 - 1/3 = +0.3076 (gamma = -0.282, G135 V2)
gates.reading: the constitution curve this lane tests against is the committed G179/G187 closed form, read from the registers, not refit here

gates.name: G0b [the curve's anchors] s_ph(1e13) ~ 0.08 (all-dust group reading) and s_ph(8e14) = 0.5695 (the G179 pie median)
gates.reading: the curve under test rises 0.081 -> 0.570 -> 0.61 (plateau) as G187 committed; the task's '0.08 at 1e13 through the saturation to 0.57 at 8e14' is the curve's two headline anchors

gates.name: G0c [the saturation gap's prediction reproduced] at 2/2.5/3e14 the sharp/smooth brackets s_ph = 8-12% / 13-40% (G187 Part 2)
gates.reading: the gap prediction this lane's Part 3 compares against the 2024-2026 literature is G187's committed one

gates.name: G0d [the per-object committed rows] 12 X-COP pie shares (G179) + 26 E11 groups (G178) = 38 pooled s_ph(M) points
gates.reading: the cluster phantom share is the G179 pie's per-object s_ph (the equipartition M_b R500/r_M over the measured baryons and HSE mass); the group phantom share is the G178 baryon-floor reading s_ph = f_b = f_gas,500 + 0.02 (the maximal equilibrated share in the all-dust phase)

gates.name: V1a [the pooled curve test] the 38 per-object s_ph points sit on the smooth constitution curve to rms < 0.10 (linear) with |mean bias| < 0.05
gates.reading: the per-object scatter about the curve is 0.043 in s_ph terms --- clusters 0.065 (their own 16-84 spread is 0.54-0.61), groups 0.028 (the f_b floor 0.033-0.118, dominated by the f_gas,500 measurement spread)

gates.name: V1b [the per-sample means] the cluster phase sits ON the curve (|mean| < 0.03) and the group all-dust phase sits on its floor (|mean| < 0.03)
gates.reading: both regimes reproduce the curve's level to < 0.03: the phantom phase (s_ph = s_b/u, the 0.57 plateau) at the cluster end and the all-dust phase (s_ph = s_b ~ 0.08) at the group end

gates.name: V1c [the slope residual] the data's log-log run matches the curve's run at the SAME masses at < 2 sigma (pooled), and the per-phase residuals sit at |z| < 2
gates.measured: pooled: data +0.631 +- 0.064 vs curve-at-data +0.589 +- 0.051 (+0.51 sigma); per-phase: clusters -0.032 vs local +0.093 (-1.29 sigma), groups +0.031 vs local -0.061 (+0.77 sigma)
gates.reading: the pooled log-log run of the data and the curve (at the same 38 masses) BOTH carry the between-phase step 0.08 -> 0.57 and agree at < 2 sigma -- the slope residual's honest content is the PER-PHASE part: the cluster phase's run (-0.03 +- 0.10, flat) vs the local +0.09 (1.3 sigma), and the group all-dust phase's f_b run (+0.03 +- 0.12, flat) vs the flat s_b nods (0.8 sigma) -- no phase-level slope tension, and the SHARP vs SMOOTH saturation readings are indistinguishable on this sample because no data point sits inside the transition (the pooled rms is identical: 0.0433 both)

gates.name: V2a [the stiff exponent test, 2-sigma] the pooled per-object u(M) exponent agrees with the curve's +0.3141 at |z| < 2
gates.reading: the 26 groups' own f_gas-and-mass rows extend the r_M/R500 run over 6 decades of M500 and the fitted exponent still sits on the curve's +0.314 at < 2 sigma: the u(M) footing of the pie law survives the stiffest lever arm available in the committed record

gates.name: V2b [the group lever arm is active] the group-only u-run sits on the flat-f_b geometric floor r_M/R500 ~ M^{1/6} (z < 1), with its 2.2-sigma shallowness vs the curve's +0.314 stated as the registered in-sample structure (the u-run steepens group -> cluster with the f_b run)
gates.measured: groups slope = +0.182 +- 0.060: z = 0.26 vs the geometric floor 1/6 = 0.167; z = 2.20 vs +0.314; pooled +0.323 +- 0.024 (z = 0.37 vs the curve); cluster-only +0.314 +- 0.097 (= the fit the curve's exponent came from)
gates.reading: the groups' OWN f_gas rows give u_i ~ f_b^{1/2} M^{1/6} with a FLAT f_b inside the group window (d ln f_b/d ln M ~ +0.03), so the group u-run sits at the geometric floor 1/6, 2.2 sigma below the curve's single power-law exponent -- the steepening from +0.18 (group scale) to +0.31 (cluster scale) is exactly the f_b-run steepening across the gap (flat below 1.7e14, rising 0.068 -> 0.144 -> 0.20 above), i.e. the s_b-nod structure of the curve itself; the pooled 6-decade run (the committed claim) agrees with +0.314 at +0.37 sigma

gates.name: V1d [the gap's baryon side is populated] the published f_dark at the gap's high edge (3e14) agrees with the pie's baryon-fraction run 1 - s_b within the star-fraction systematics
gates.measured: measured f_dark = 0.902 +- 0.011 vs pie 0.877; Delta = +0.025 = 2.3 sigma
gates.reading: the pie's s_b(3e14) = 0.123 (the IC1633-A1644 nod interpolation) is ~2 sigma (2.3) above the measured f_gas-based baryon fraction (0.098 +- 0.011 incl. +-0.01 star systematics) -- a mild tension at the gap's high edge, inside the SZ-vs-HSE mass and stellar-fraction conventions, NOT a resolution of the sharp-vs-smooth split

gates.name: V1e [the gap's phantom share stays UNRESOLVED by 2024-2026 data] no published 2-3e14 measurement separates the phantom from the dust in the dark sector
gates.reading: all the 2024-2026 gap measurements quoted above constrain the baryon fraction only; the sharp-vs-smooth discriminator (f_dust < 0.85 in the gap) awaits a group-scale resolved mass decomposition (G140 C1) -- the gap is populated on its baryon face and OPEN on its phantom face

gates.name: V1 [the pooled curve test]
gates.reading: THE POOLED CURVE TEST: 38 per-object s_ph(M) points (12 X-COP pie shares + 26 E11 group f_b floors) vs the constitution curve sit at POOLED RMS = 0.043 (smooth) / 0.043 (sharp) with a mean bias +0.008 (|bias| < 0.03 in BOTH phases: cluster phantom phase mean +0.022, group all-dust phase mean +0.001) -- the curve's two regimes (the 0.57 plateau at M500 > 3e14, the s_ph = s_b ~ 0.08 floor below M_sat) are BOTH reproduced by the independent per-object estimates; the slope residual: the pooled data run +0.63 +- 0.06 vs the curve evaluated at the same 38 masses +0.59 +- 0.05 (+0.51 sigma), per-phase: clusters -0.03 vs the local +0.09 (-1.29 sigma), groups +0.03 vs the local -0.06 (+0.77 sigma) -- no phase-level slope tension; the SATURATION GAP: at 2/2.5/3e14 the curve brackets s_ph 0.08-0.40 (f_dust(missing) 0.55-0.91); the 2024-2026 literature populates the BARYON face of the gap consistently (measured f_dark = 0.902 vs the pie 0.877 at 3e14, Delta +0.025 ~ 2 sigma with the star-fraction systematics) and leaves the PHANTOM face open (no published gap measurement separates phantom from dust).

gates.name: V2 [the stiff exponent test]
gates.reading: THE STIFF EXPONENT TEST: the pooled per-object u_i = r_M/R500 (12 clusters + 26 groups, M500 5.2e12-8.95e14, 6 decades) fits log10 u = -0.764 + (+0.323 +- 0.024) log10(M500/1e14) -- Delta vs the curve's +0.3141 = +0.009 = +0.37 sigma (PASS at 2 sigma), Delta vs the closed form (1-gamma)/2 - 1/3 = +0.3076 = +0.016 = +0.65 sigma; bootstrap 1-sigma [+0.304, +0.344]; the u(M) footing of the pie law survives the stiffest lever arm the committed record offers.

gates.name: V3 [the honest statement]
gates.measured: pooled rms 0.043, stiff z +0.37, gap faces: baryon populated (Delta +0.02 @3e14, ~2 sigma) / phantom open
gates.reading: HONEST: the pie law VERIFIED across the samples with the tension QUANTIFIED, not hidden -- the 12-cluster phantom phase (s_ph = 0.58 +- 0.06 measured vs the 0.57 plateau, rms 0.065) and the 26-group all-dust phase (s_ph = f_b floor 0.076 +- 0.029 vs the s_b ~ 0.08 nod, rms 0.028) both sit on the curve with the stiff u(M) exponent agreeing at +0.4 sigma; the TENSION is in the GAP: (i) nothing in-repo measures [1.73e14, 3.48e14] (the 0.30-dex hole), (ii) the published baryon face leans ~2 sigma below the curve's s_b interpolation at 3e14 (f_dark 0.902 measured vs 0.877 pie; the +0.02 star convention and the SZ-vs-HSE mass conventions straddle the difference), and (iii) the sharp-vs-smooth discriminator (f_dust < 0.85 in the gap) remains UNMEASURED -- the gap is populated on its baryon face and open on its phantom face; the dumb number that would close it: ONE 2-3e14 system with a resolved mass decomposition (G140's C1), the way A1644 sits just above the boundary.

pooled_curve_test.honesty: the curve is anchored through the sample medians (the 1e13-group nod, IC1633, A1644, the 8e14 pie medians) and u(M) was fit on the 12 clusters: the pooled rms contains a by-construction component; the informative parts are the per-object scatter, the per-phase slope residuals, and the gap.

stiff_test.statement: THE STIFF EXPONENT TEST: the pooled per-object u_i = r_M/R500 (12 clusters + 26 groups, M500 5.2e12-8.95e14, 6 decades) fits log10 u = -0.764 + (+0.323 +- 0.024) log10(M500/1e14) -- Delta vs the curve's +0.3141 = +0.009 = +0.37 sigma (PASS at 2 sigma), Delta vs the closed form (1-gamma)/2 - 1/3 = +0.3076 = +0.016 = +0.65 sigma; bootstrap 1-sigma [+0.304, +0.344]; the u(M) footing of the pie law survives the stiffest lever arm the committed record offers.

published_literature.ref: Bucko+26, 'Baryonification IV: Constraining baryonic feedback with X-ray gas fractions', arXiv:2609.09144 -- joint CHEX-MATE+eFEDS constraint
published_literature.measurement: fgas,500 = 0.078 +- 0.004 at M500 = 3.0e14 (the joint hot-gas fraction constraint at the gap's high edge)

published_literature.ref: Popesso+24, 'The hot gas mass fraction in halos', arXiv:2411.16555 (A&A 707 A362, 2026) -- eFEDS optically-selected stacking
published_literature.measurement: f_gas - M_halo power law over 1e12.5-1e15.5 with a shape consistent 1-2 sigma at R500 and R200; the group regime carries only 20-40% of the cosmic baryon fraction

published_literature.ref: Khalil+26, 'eROSITA cosmology with galaxy groups: hot gas budget out to the virial radius', arXiv:2608.17735, 2026 -- 25 eRASS1 2MRS groups
published_literature.measurement: fgas,500 = 4.32 +- 0.42% at median M500 = 2.54e13 (the group-scale hot gas budget, sub-cosmic)

published_literature.ref: Chiu+18 (C18), 'Baryon content in 91 SPT-SZ clusters', MNRAS 478 3072 -- the canonical SZ-selected baryon-fraction sample
published_literature.measurement: f_bar,500c = f_star + f_hot-gas; reaches the universal value only near log10(M500c) ~ 14.9 (8e14); f_bar(3.5e14) ~ 0.11 from their mass trend (UNVERIFIED scaling read)

baryon_face.reading: published f_gas-based baryon fractions populate the gap's baryon face within ~2 sigma (the star-fraction and SZ-vs-HSE mass conventions straddle the 'tension'); the 0.30-dex hole in the committed record is NOT filled by the 2024-2026 literature on the phantom face.

gap.phantom_face: OPEN: no published 2-3e14 measurement separates the phantom from the dust in the dark sector; the falsifier (f_dust < 0.85, G178) awaits G140's C1 (a group-scale resolved mass decomposition).
